description: This Java class defines a custom runtime exception named PermissionCantBeMakerCheckerableException, which is thrown when a permission cannot be set as maker-checker enabled within the Fineract platform. The class extends AbstractPlatformResourceNotFoundException and provides a constructor that constructs an exception message based on a permission code.

classes.name: PermissionCantBeMakerCheckerableException
classes.description: A RuntimeException subclass used to indicate that a specific permission cannot be marked as maker-checker enabled.

methods.name: PermissionCantBeMakerCheckerableException
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a specific permission code and an appropriate error message.
